title: ACSE Resource Index 1.0
description: Spec 02d Finding the code, ledger 02d section 0b and spec 02d Amendment 1 (Koushik, 2026-11-04: O-1 'L-2 forbids reading the customer’s run logs, plans and variables. ACSE’s validation plan of its own proposed change is ACSE’s artifact, produced offline in the runtime, scanned, and retained only as a verdict. The CI gate is unchange'; O-3 'Opt-in as L-2 (Recommended)'; O-4 '02d governs (Recommended)'; O-7 'From the locator (Recommended)'; the other fourteen items the recommended default, standing unless he objects; contracts/docs/decisions/02d-finding-the-code-transport-24.md). Awaiting Koushik's approval. Contract C-1, spec 02d section 3 (L-3): the sanitized resource index the customer's own apply job writes, after apply, with ACSE's open acse-index filter (terraform show -json | acse-index --repo --dir --commit --run), to <prefix>/<repo>/<dir>/<commit>.json in a bucket prefix ACSE may only read. One object per apply of one root: the root (repository, working directory), the commit and run it was applied from, when, which filter produced it, and per managed resource only its address, type, provider, module path and, for the cloud providers ACSE scans (aws, google, google-beta, azurerm, azuread; ledger 02d O-10), its cloud id. Never an attribute value, output, variable, sensitive value, data source or provider configuration: every object is additionalProperties false, so a filter the customer replaced cannot add a value and still be read. A data source is dropped by the filter and refused here. The customer may audit or replace the filter; this schema is what ACSE reads (validated on read, nightly and on demand, L-7). It stays in the customer's bucket and the customer runtime, so it has no egress row (the routing-1.0 precedent).

repository.$comment: A repository as its code host names it (owner/name, or a host's deeper path). A name: it stays in the customer's runtime and crosses only where a delivery's names rule allows.

working_directory.$comment: Repository-relative; . is the root. Printable, one line.

run_ref.$comment: The apply run the location was observed from: a Terraform Cloud / Enterprise run id (run-...) or the run reference the customer's pipeline wrote into its resource index.

indexProducer.$comment: The filter that wrote the object: acse-index (binary or script) or the customer's own.

address.$comment: The resource's full address, module path included (module.a.aws_s3_bucket.b).

provider.$comment: The provider's source address as Terraform names it, e.g. registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws.

module_path.$comment: The module address the resource sits in; absent at the root.

cloud_id.$comment: The resource's identity in its cloud (aws: arn, else id; google: self_link, else id; azure: id). Only for the scanned cloud providers (O-10).

allOf.$comment: Managed resources only: a data source (data.<type>.<name>, at the root or inside any module path) is never indexed; a module named data is not a data source. Validation-only.
A cloud id only for the providers ACSE scans (ledger 02d O-10): a utility provider's id (random_string's id is its value) is never kept. Validation-only.
